answer: An agent economy can resist sybils through audited storage: the k-th key an operator links must keep k^2 GB of archived chain history online, and a random beacon each epoch picks keys to return hashes of random blocks within seconds. Key one holds 1 GB, key ten 100 GB, key 1,000 holds 1,000,000 GB, so 1,000 fakes need 333,833,500 GB. Each onyx-sized relic of data must be real disk, so clones cannot share it. Weakness: operators can rent one pooled storage network and fetch blocks on demand.
